## Diff and risk audit

- [ ] `git status`, all diffs, and every untracked file were inspected.
- [ ] No unrelated refactor, formatting churn, generated noise, or weakened test was introduced.
- [ ] No secret, raw-coordinate retention, privacy boundary, dependency, schema, or public-contract change is hidden in the diff.
- [ ] Retry/idempotency and recovery behavior are defined where applicable.
- [ ] Independent review is complete for architectural work.

## Residual risk and follow-up
